subject: MAP: sandbox access & testcase exchange — TruVantage pilot
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@truvantage.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: sandbox access & testcase exchange — TruVantage pilot

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the demo last week — appreciate the candid feedback from your ML team. Per our conversation, I sketched a short mutual action plan (MAP) to get a small closed pilot running: the goal is to exchange a constrained set of evaluation materials (prompt packs + 3 lightweight test suites), run them against a pinned model on our hosted sandbox, and validate quality/latency before we expand to dedicated capacity.

High-level proposed MAP (milestones + owners):
- Week 0 (you): NDA sign + procurement intake (send redlines to procurement@truvantage.com)
- Week 0–1 (us): SOC2 summary + network access prep (we'll provide pre-signed S3 links and ephemeral sandbox credentials)
- Week 1 (joint): Prompt pack delivery (TruVantage supplies sample prompts / test cases), Redwood uploads to sandbox with usage constraints
- Week 2–3 (TruVantage): Evaluation window (we provide token-level logs + per-route latency cost)
- Week 4 (joint): Review results, decide close/expand (contract and reserved capacity next steps)

Constraints we need from you for sample exchange:
- Data should be synthetic or redacted PII; if real customer data is included it must be consented and marked in the manifest.
- Ephemeral access only: Redwood will not persist raw testcases beyond 30 days post-pilot unless explicitly agreed.
- No redistribution clause: testcases/prompt packs are for pilot use only and must be returned/destroyed per the MAP.

Attached: MAP-draft.pdf (one-page milestone table) and sample-prompt-pack.csv (example format).

If that looks good, can you loop in procurement/legal and share an initial NDA redline? If you prefer, we can run a short 30-minute kickoff to lock dates — I have availability Tue/Wed afternoon.

Best,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior ABM, Redwood Inference
[karthik_iyer@redwood.com]
[Attachment: MAP-draft.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: sample-prompt-pack.csv (text/csv)]

From: Emily Chen <emily@truvantage.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@truvantage.com, James Owen <james.owen@truvantage.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: sandbox access & testcase exchange — TruVantage pilot

Karthik —

Thanks, this is helpful. Procurement looped in; attaching our NDA redline. A few clarifications from the technical team:
- We require a short data handling paragraph in the MAP that states Redwood will limit retention and provide an audited deletion confirmation.
- SOC2 summary is necessary but not sufficient for our InfoSec team; they will want an explicit list of ACLs and the pre-signed URL expiry policy.

We will prepare an initial set of 150 synthetic prompts and two small test suites (50 cases each) by Feb 8 if the NDA is approved. Our preferred timeline would be: data transfer Feb 9–10, evaluation Feb 11–24, mutual review week of Feb 25.

Attached: NDA-redline.docx (redlined doc). Procurement also asked for an estimated cost for short-term sandbox consumption — a simple per-token estimate will do for now.

Emily Chen
Head of ML Platform, TruVantage
[Attachment: NDA-redline.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@truvantage.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: sandbox access & testcase exchange — TruVantage pilot

Emily —

Appreciate the specificity. Quick responses to your points:
1) Retention/deletion: we can commit to a 30-day retention window for raw prompts/testcases by default and provide a signed deletion statement when the pilot closes. We'll add the exact language to the MAP and to the NDA where appropriate.
2) Pre-signed URL policy: pre-signed links we provide will default to 24-hour expiry; if you want shorter windows we can do that. We'll include ACL details in the SOC2 summary (attached).
3) Cost: for a small pilot like this we're happy to provide an estimate — rough ballpark is $0.015 per 1k tokens for hosted sandbox usage (estimate only). Ben (cc'd) will provide a more precise example invoice based on expected token counts.

Next steps I suggest:
- Redwood: upload an annotated MAP (I attached MAP-v1.pdf) with the definitive retention clause + deletion workflow.
- TruVantage: return NDA redline with any showstopper edits by EOD Thu (Feb 4).
- Schedule: provisional data handoff Feb 9–10; please confirm preferred times and whether the S3 transfer is acceptable.

Attached: redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf, MAP-v1.pdf.

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: sandbox access & testcase exchange — TruVantage pilot

Hi Emily / Karthik —

Laura from Redwood Legal here — thanks for sending the redline. We reviewed the NDA and left a few comments focused on data minimization and destruction verification. Main notes:
- We can accept an explicit 30-day retention term for pilot materials, but we request a narrow exception to preserve aggregated non-identifying metrics for platform improvement (we will never include raw testcases in public corpora).
- For deletion verification we propose a signed deletion certificate and a short audit snapshot (hashes of files deleted) rather than full content logs.
- Please confirm whether TruVantage requires a mutual indemnification paragraph for customer-supplied testcases. If so, we will ask for limited carve-outs aligned to our standard terms.

I've attached a PDF of our comments in the redline for ease of review. Happy to hop on a quick legal-ops call if that helps clear the remaining items.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: NDA-redline-comments.pdf (application/pdf)]

Karthik / Emily —

Thanks all for the quick turnaround. Procurement reviewed Redwood's comments and we can accept the 30-day retention window provided:
- Redwood provides deletion certificate within five business days of the pilot close.
- TruVantage will not distribute testcases beyond the pilot scope.

Confirmed timeline we can commit to:
- Feb 9–10: Secure transfer of prompt pack + test suites (S3 pre-signed URLs ok)
- Feb 11–24: Evaluation run (TruVantage runs tests, Redwood provides logs and per-route latency/cost summaries)
- Week of Feb 25: Joint debrief and decision to close/expand
- Feb 28: If agreed, sign contract for reserved capacity and production onboarding (tentative)

Please send the final MAP PDF and a DocuSign link for the NDA when ready. I'm attaching the procurement PO template they asked us to fill out later.

James Owen
Director, Platform Engineering, TruVantage
